hook: Famous actors usually direct safe studio films, but James McAvoy spent 30 years waiting to break every rule.

sections.voiceover: Famous actors usually direct safe studio films, but James McAvoy spent 30 years waiting to break every rule.
b_roll: Actor James McAvoy on set directing his feature film

sections.voiceover: In October 2026, James McAvoy released California Schemin' in U.S. theaters after premiering at the Toronto Film Festival. How'd a limited budget force McAvoy to involve 2,000 strangers?
b_roll: California Schemin' theater poster and festival screening footage
Director James McAvoy speaking in an interview

sections.voiceover: Except a limited budget meant McAvoy needed 2,000 strangers to pull it off.
b_roll: Crowded street scene during film production

sections.voiceover: McAvoy utilized 2,000 strangers to help execute an ambitious scene for California Schemin'. Ben Affleck also conquered the director's chair with his thriller Animals.
b_roll: Massive crowd of extras on a movie set
Ben Affleck directing in Los Angeles for Netflix Tudum

sections.voiceover: 30 years of waiting finally built California Schemin'.
